description: Refresh an agency status visual (client content pipeline, approval queue, or client interview progress) inside a Notion page. The snapshot is refreshed in place from BAMF data, it never publishes posts, and it is for agency staff only (platform admin or owner/admin/manager). dry_run=true returns the HTML without calling Notion. Requires client_approvals:write (client_approvals:read for dry_run).

block_id.description: Existing block id to update in place (agency-wide kinds).

notion_page_id.description: Target Notion page; defaults to the client binding's internal OS page.

workspace_id.description: Agency workspace (all its clients) or a single client workspace. interview_progress needs a client workspace.

name: bamf.publish_notion_status_block
